entries.german:
Otakar, Herr des Königreiches Böhmen usw, bestätigt dem Kloster Kremsmünster auf Bitten des Abtes Berthold die (eingerückte) Urkunde Herzog Leopold V: 1189 Jänner 4, Salchenau (mit ungenauer Anführung einiger weniger Zeugen).

Otacharas dei gratia dominus Regni Bohemie, Dux Austrie, Marchio Morauie Vniuersis presentia inspecturis in perpetuum. Dilectus nobis Bertholdus abbas in Chremsmunster nostre celsitudini supplicauit, quatenus subscriptum Priuilegium a bone memorie Levpoldo Duce Monasterio suo concessum dignaremur eidem per nostre renouacionis gratiam confirmare. (Hier folgt die Urkunde des Herzoges Leopold, dat. Salchenau am 4. Jänner 1189.) Nos igitur, quod ab eodem duce ac memoratis Comitibus in hac parte pie ac prouide factum est, ratum et gratum habentes, possessiones superius espressas antedicto monasterio in Chremsmunster per hanc nostre Celsitudinis paginam iure perpetuo duximus confirmandum. Testes: Otto Patauiensis Episcopus, Chunradus Frisingensis Electus, Hermannus Abbas de Altah, Otto et Chunradus Comites de Plein. Heinricus et Wernhardus de Schavmberch, Wocho de Rosenberch, Chunradus de Zecking, Lvdwicus et Wernherus de Zelking, Albero et Wichardus de Polnheim, Vlricus de Chappell, Vlricus de Lobnstein, Sighardus et Rvdgerus de Piber, Siboto et Arnoldns de Lonstorf, Ernestus et Chunradus de Asperch, Merboto de Oed, Ernestus de Stein, Heinricvs et Otto de Ahleiten, Otto de Chvstilwanch et alii plurimj. Datum in Wels per manum magistri Arnoldi prothonotarij nostrj, In mense Octobri, Anno dominj M. CC. LVIII. Indictione ...
entries.english: Otakar, lord of the kingdom of Bohemia, Duke of Austria and Margrave of Moravia, at the request of Abbot Berthold, confirms for Kremsmünster the inserted charter of Duke Leopold V dated 4 January 1189 at Salchenau. He confirms in perpetuity the possessions granted to the monastery. Witnesses include the bishops of Passau and Freising, Abbot Hermann of Altah, the counts of Plein, Heinrich and Wernhard of Schaumberg, Wocho of Rosenberch, and many others. Given at Wels in October 1258.
